0022600219.text: The Raptors (5-5, 6th in the East) host the Celtics (8-2, 2nd in the East) in Toronto's 11th game of the season, with Toronto coming off a loss and Boston riding a three-game win streak. Kawhi Leonard and Nate Bittle are out for Toronto, while Collin Murray-Boyles (illness), Immanuel Quickley (hamstring), and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, and Boston won the four games they played against Toronto in 2025-26, most recently 115-101 in Boston on April 5, 2026.
